unlock.onset_sd: Supply offset-aware main sleep instants on four nights including a weekend.
unlock.meal_fibre: Confirm complete days and fibre for every meal.
unlock.food_pattern: Submit a complete food week with portion totals.
unlock.aerobic: Supply repeated eligible sessions with duration or measured intensity.

sleep_hours.unit: hours asleep within the main sleep period per night

curve.bin_edges: Zero is the reference. Any positive amount below 7.5 maps to the lowest nonzero published bin (study rounded to 0.1).

vilpa.unit: min/day in vigorous lifestyle bouts lasting ≤2 min

curve.bound_origin: Assumed product bounds and reference. Only the per-increment estimate and interval are published.
Assumed product bounds and reference. Only the per-increment estimate and interval are published.

grip.unit: kg difference from protocol-matched age/sex reference

curve.bound_origin: Assumed product bounds and reference. Only the per-increment estimate and interval are published.

Assumed product bounds and reference. Only the per-increment estimate and interval are published.

curve.bin_edges: Zero is the abstainer reference. Any positive intake below 1.3 is occasional. Subsequent edges are inclusive.

overlap.cap_rule: If the sum of absolute contributions exceeds the budget, multiply each by budget divided by that sum. Fixed budgets, ordering, time constants and shrinkage are modeling assumptions.

context_reasons.hrv-rmssd: Overnight RMSSD from one device can show a pulse-variability trend.
context_reasons.sleep-efficiency: Track sleep continuity. A validated device-specific comparison is needed.
context_reasons.sleep-score: Vendor scores use different scales. Measured minutes asleep can contribute.
context_reasons.deep-sleep-minutes: Track sleep stages. Total minutes asleep can contribute.
context_reasons.estimated-vo2-max: Two dated estimates from one supported watch or a measured exercise test can contribute.
context_reasons.distance-km: Distance alone does not identify steps or effort. Recorded wearable steps can contribute.
context_reasons.floors-climbed: Floor counts vary by device. Recorded wearable steps can contribute.
context_reasons.blood_pressure_protocol: A paired cuff protocol with timing and setting can supply the pressure comparison.
context_reasons.workout_minutes: Repeated dated sessions and duration support a weekly comparison. Verified intensity can qualify other session types.
context_reasons.whoop_standard_zones: Standard zones qualify intensity records when those records become available.
context_reasons.unit_mismatch: A result in the documented unit can enter this comparison.
context_reasons.unmapped_lab: A documented canonical marker and matching unit are needed.

rank_sources.lifting: NHIS 2015 strength sessions per week, logged-days proxy
rank_sources.lpa: NHANES III phase 2 mass assay, historical reference

extra_context.workouts: Use a verified habitual exposure or protocol-matched test.
extra_context.meals: Log meals with fibre and calories on several dates.
extra_context.fitness_tests: Test method, equipment, age and verification determine eligibility.
extra_context.family_history: Family history can inform a discussion with a clinician.
extra_context.social_connection: Tracks self-reported support. An independent coefficient is unavailable.
extra_context.stress: Track within-person mood and stress. Vendor scales have no mortality-age calibration.
extra_context.medications: Medication and condition flags qualify affected measurements.
extra_context.hrv: Compare like-for-like RMSSD or SDNN over time.
extra_context.other_fields: Unsupported lab, body, sleep or device measurements remain available for trends.

ldl.role: published with method and unit checks

albumin.what_it_is: Albumin is the main protein in the liquid part of blood.
albumin.what_helps: Seeing albumin beside total protein gives the result more context.

creatinine.what_it_is: Creatinine is a waste product that kidneys filter from blood.
creatinine.what_helps: Compare the result with prior creatinine and the lab's kidney filtration estimate.

rdw.what_it_is: This measures how much red blood cells vary in size.
rdw.what_helps: Looking at red cell size and hemoglobin alongside this result gives a fuller picture.

wbc.what_it_is: This counts the white blood cells that help fight infection.
wbc.what_helps: A note about illness at the time helps explain changes between blood draws.

crp.what_it_is: This protein rises with inflammation, including during short illnesses.
crp.what_helps: A reading taken when well is easier to compare with earlier results.

a1c.what_it_is: This shows the share of hemoglobin carrying sugar over recent months.
a1c.what_helps: Following several results shows how average blood sugar changes over time.

ggt.what_it_is: This enzyme comes mostly from the liver and bile ducts.
ggt.what_helps: Compare this enzyme with the other liver measurements from the same draw.

alp.what_it_is: This enzyme comes mainly from the liver and bones.
alp.what_helps: The lab's own range helps put this enzyme level in context.

bun.what_it_is: This measures nitrogen left in blood after the body breaks down protein.
bun.what_helps: Viewing this beside creatinine gives a fuller picture of the kidney measurements.

phosphate.what_it_is: This mineral helps cells use energy and helps build bones.
phosphate.what_helps: Using the same units makes phosphate results from different labs comparable.

globulin.what_it_is: This group of blood proteins includes antibodies.
globulin.what_helps: Albumin and total protein help put globulin in context.

uric_acid.what_it_is: This is a waste product from the breakdown of certain natural substances.
uric_acid.what_helps: Several results show whether a higher reading is unusual for you.

lymph.what_it_is: This is the share of white blood cells called lymphocytes.
lymph.what_helps: Read the percentage alongside the total white blood cell count.

mcv.what_it_is: This measures the average size of a red blood cell.
mcv.what_helps: Hemoglobin and the spread of red cell sizes help explain this average.

hemoglobin.what_it_is: This protein inside red blood cells carries oxygen.
hemoglobin.what_helps: Tracking hemoglobin alongside red cell size helps show changes over time.

platelets.what_it_is: These small blood cells help form clots.
platelets.what_helps: Earlier counts help show whether the current result is typical for you.

co2.what_it_is: This blood test mostly measures bicarbonate, which helps balance acids.
co2.what_helps: The other salts from the same panel give this result context.

sodium.what_it_is: This mineral helps balance water and supports nerve signals.
sodium.what_helps: The lab's own range is a useful comparison for this result.

potassium.what_it_is: This mineral helps muscles and nerves work.
potassium.what_helps: A sample-quality flag can affect how a potassium reading is interpreted.

chloride.what_it_is: This mineral helps balance fluids and acids.
chloride.what_helps: Read chloride alongside sodium and bicarbonate from the same draw.

calcium.what_it_is: This mineral supports bones, nerves and muscles.
calcium.what_helps: Albumin from the same draw helps put total calcium in context.

bilirubin_total.what_it_is: This pigment comes from the breakdown of old red blood cells.
bilirubin_total.what_helps: Separate direct and total bilirubin results describe different parts of the measurement.

ast.what_it_is: This enzyme occurs in muscle, liver and other tissues.
ast.what_helps: Recording recent strenuous exercise gives this result more context.

alt.what_it_is: This enzyme occurs mainly in the liver.
alt.what_helps: Compare ALT with AST and the other liver tests from the same panel.

total_protein.what_it_is: This measures albumin and other proteins together.
total_protein.what_helps: Albumin and globulin show which proteins contribute to the total.

acr.what_it_is: This compares albumin with creatinine in a urine sample.
acr.what_helps: Use the albumin and creatinine from the same urine sample.

non_hdl.what_it_is: This is total cholesterol minus HDL cholesterol from the same blood draw.
non_hdl.what_helps: Total cholesterol and HDL from the same draw give a comparable result.

homocysteine.what_it_is: This is a substance formed as the body processes an amino acid.
homocysteine.what_helps: Using the same lab and units helps show longer-term changes.

ferritin.what_it_is: This protein stores iron and can rise during illness.
ferritin.what_helps: Recording illness around the blood draw helps interpret changes in iron stores.

vitamin_d_25oh.what_it_is: This is the usual blood measure of vitamin D stores.
vitamin_d_25oh.what_helps: Dates and units help put seasonal changes in context.

ldl_c.what_it_is: This measures the cholesterol carried by LDL particles.
ldl_c.what_helps: Repeated comparable LDL values show whether the level is sustained.

lpa.what_it_is: This measures an inherited type of particle that carries cholesterol.
lpa.what_helps: Keep the original units because mass and particle counts use different scales.

sbp.what_it_is: The upper number measures pressure while the heart pumps.
sbp.what_helps: Use the same cuff and seated routine for repeat readings.

bmi.what_it_is: This compares body weight with height.
bmi.what_helps: Use a consistent scale on a firm surface.

waist.what_it_is: This measures the distance around the waist.
waist.what_helps: Measure at the same spot each time.

pulse.what_it_is: This is the heart rate recorded while resting.
pulse.what_helps: Compare resting readings from the same device across several days.

activity.what_it_is: This describes usual leisure activity adjusted for reported effort.
activity.what_helps: Record the duration and effort of each activity.

sleep.what_it_is: This is the time spent asleep.
sleep.what_helps: A regular sleep opportunity can make sleep duration more consistent.

smoking.what_it_is: This reflects cigarette use and time since stopping.
smoking.what_helps: More time smoke-free moves the comparison toward long-term former smokers.

disease.what_it_is: This records a history of selected major health conditions.
disease.what_helps: Keep the history current so the comparison uses the right context.

health.what_it_is: This is a person's overall rating of their health.
health.what_helps: Use the same scale when answering again.

phq9.what_it_is: This sums nine answers about mood and daily functioning.
phq9.what_helps: Complete every question using the same two-week period.

diabetes.what_it_is: This records whether diabetes has been diagnosed outside pregnancy.
diabetes.what_helps: Keep the check-in current when a diagnosis changes.

gait.what_it_is: This is walking speed over a measured course.
gait.what_helps: Repeat the same distance with the same timing method.

knee.what_it_is: This measures knee extension force on a testing machine.
knee.what_helps: Use the same equipment and setup when comparing tests.

vo2.what_it_is: This estimates how much oxygen the body uses during exercise.
vo2.what_helps: Repeat the same treadmill protocol for comparable results.

fev1.what_it_is: This measures the air breathed out in the first second of a forced breath.
fev1.what_helps: Compare tests performed with the same technique.

fibre.what_it_is: This estimates the usual amount of fibre eaten each day.
fibre.what_helps: Beans, whole grains and fruit are sources of fibre.

alcohol.what_it_is: This estimates the average alcohol in usual daily drinks.
alcohol.what_helps: Tracking drink sizes makes weekly totals easier to compare.

steps.what_it_is: This counts the steps the device recorded each day.
steps.what_helps: Carrying or wearing the same device consistently improves the comparison.

hip_minutes.what_it_is: This estimates active minutes recorded by a research movement monitor.
hip_minutes.what_helps: Use the same monitor protocol across days.

sleep_regularity.what_it_is: This compares sleep and wake patterns on consecutive days.
sleep_regularity.what_helps: A consistent sleep opportunity makes day-to-day patterns easier to compare.

l5_midpoint.what_it_is: This marks the middle of the five quietest hours of the day.
l5_midpoint.what_helps: Several full days on the same device improve the estimate.

vilpa.what_it_is: These are brief bursts of hard movement during everyday activities.
vilpa.what_helps: Comparable minute-level recordings help distinguish short bursts.

sedentary.what_it_is: This estimates time spent sedentary while awake.
sedentary.what_helps: Short walking breaks add movement to seated routines.

lifting.what_it_is: This records how often a person lifts weights.
lifting.what_helps: Log sessions consistently over several weeks.

running.what_it_is: This averages the minutes of recorded runs across four weeks.
running.what_helps: Consistent session logs make running habits easier to see.

vo2_peak.what_it_is: This estimates the body's peak oxygen use during exercise.
vo2_peak.what_helps: Use the same device or repeat the same lab test.

grip.what_it_is: This measures grip strength across both hands.
grip.what_helps: Use the same dynamometer and hand positions each time.

floor_rise.what_it_is: This scores sitting down and rising from the floor with support deductions.
floor_rise.what_helps: Use the same support rules for each attempt.

balance.what_it_is: This records completion of a timed one-leg balance test.
balance.what_helps: Use the same stance and timing rules.

gait_speed.what_it_is: This measures walking pace under a specified protocol.
gait_speed.what_helps: Use a measured course and the same timing method.

sauna.what_it_is: This records frequency of traditional sauna use.
sauna.what_helps: Keep the type and frequency of sessions consistent in the log.

diet_pattern.what_it_is: This summarises the overall pattern of foods eaten.
diet_pattern.what_helps: Record complete days across the week.

whole_grains.what_helps: Oats and whole-grain bread contribute to this measure.

vegetables.what_helps: Adding vegetables to familiar meals changes this average.

fruit.what_it_is: This estimates whole fruit eaten across the week.
fruit.what_helps: Whole fruit at meals or snacks contributes to this average.

nuts.what_it_is: This estimates the amount of nuts eaten.
nuts.what_helps: Report nuts separately from beans and seeds.

legumes.what_it_is: This estimates the amount of beans, peas and lentils eaten.
legumes.what_helps: Report legumes separately from nuts and seeds.

fish.what_it_is: This estimates the amount of fish eaten.
fish.what_helps: Record the portion and preparation when known.

red_meat.what_it_is: This estimates unprocessed red meat eaten each week.
red_meat.what_helps: Record it separately from cured and processed meats.

processed_meat.what_it_is: This estimates meat preserved by curing, smoking or similar processing.
processed_meat.what_helps: Recording processed meat separately improves the estimate.

sugary_drinks.what_it_is: This estimates the volume of drinks with added sugar.
sugary_drinks.what_helps: Record drinks separately from unsweetened juice.

aerobic.what_it_is: Time spent in repeated aerobic sessions.
aerobic.what_helps: Record the session length and any verified intensity minutes.

onset_sd.what_it_is: How much your sleep start time varies across nights.
onset_sd.what_helps: Recording weekday and weekend nights gives a fuller picture.

hrv.what_it_is: Overnight beat-to-beat variability on one device.
hrv.what_helps: Compare measurements taken with the same method.

meal_fibre.what_it_is: Fibre in meals on days marked complete.
meal_fibre.what_helps: Include all meals and confirm the day when finished.

food_pattern.what_it_is: Seven-day portions reflecting several components of diet quality.
food_pattern.what_helps: A complete week captures foods eaten occasionally as well as daily staples.

apob.what_it_is: ApoB counts particles that carry cholesterol and can form plaque inside arteries.
apob.what_helps: A dated result with units supports comparison across draws.

ldl.what_helps: Record changes in treatment alongside the measurement.

egfr.what_it_is: An estimate of how quickly the kidneys filter blood.
egfr.what_helps: Compare the result with urine albumin and previous kidney measurements.

homa_ir.what_it_is: Fasting insulin and glucose from the same draw estimate insulin resistance.
homa_ir.what_helps: Record both results and the fasting status.

fasting_glucose.what_helps: Confirm fasting status and units on the report.

triglycerides.what_helps: Fasting status helps interpret changes between draws.

iron.what_helps: Interpret alongside ferritin, hemoglobin and recent illness.

whtr.what_helps: Use the same waist measurement site over time.

weight_loss.what_it_is: Reported unintentional loss over roughly one year.
weight_loss.what_helps: Keep the measurement dates and whether the change was intentional.

omega_3_index.what_it_is: EPA and DHA as a percentage of red-cell fatty acids.
omega_3_index.what_helps: Compare results measured in the same blood fraction.

lean_change.what_it_is: Change in measured lean mass over six weeks to six months.
lean_change.what_helps: Use the same device and method under similar conditions.

lpa_molar.what_it_is: This blood test counts inherited lipoprotein(a) particles that carry cholesterol.
lpa_molar.what_helps: Keep the original assay units when comparing results.

meal_density.what_it_is: Fibre per thousand calories in the meals you logged.
meal_density.what_helps: Logging different meals across several days gives a fuller picture.

caffeine_timing.what_it_is: Typical time between your last logged caffeine and recorded sleep.
caffeine_timing.what_helps: Include amounts and local meal times to track the pattern.

alcohol_timing.what_it_is: Typical time between your last logged alcohol and recorded sleep.
alcohol_timing.what_helps: Record drink amounts and times when comparing sleep across nights.

alcohol_peak.what_it_is: Most standard drinks reported in one sitting during your food week.
alcohol_peak.what_helps: Recording the occasion alongside the weekly total preserves both details.

oral_rating.what_it_is: A personal rating of the condition of the teeth.
oral_rating.what_helps: Compare repeated measurements taken with the same protocol.

edentulous.what_it_is: This records whether all natural teeth are missing.
edentulous.what_helps: Compare repeated measurements taken with the same protocol.

chair.what_it_is: Difficulty standing up from a chair describes everyday physical function.
chair.what_helps: Compare repeated measurements taken with the same protocol.

hospital.what_it_is: This records an overnight hospital stay in the past year.
hospital.what_helps: Compare repeated measurements taken with the same protocol.

k6.what_it_is: Six questions measure recent psychological distress.
k6.what_helps: Compare repeated measurements taken with the same protocol.

delayed.what_it_is: A delayed recall task measures how many words someone remembers.
delayed.what_helps: Compare repeated measurements taken with the same protocol.

vision.what_it_is: Reported difficulty seeing even with usual correction.
vision.what_helps: Compare repeated measurements taken with the same protocol.

cac.what_it_is: This scan measures calcium in the arteries that supply the heart.
cac.what_helps: Compare repeated measurements taken with the same protocol.

zone_intensity.what_it_is: Workout intensity is estimated from minutes in recorded heart-rate zones.
zone_intensity.what_helps: Compare sessions recorded with the same heart-rate settings.

pta.what_it_is: A hearing test measures the quietest sounds heard at several pitches.
pta.what_helps: Compare repeat hearing tests taken under the same conditions.

snellen.what_it_is: An eye chart measures how clearly someone can see at a distance.
snellen.what_helps: Record which eye and correction the test used.

ahi.what_it_is: A sleep study counts pauses or reductions in breathing per hour of sleep.
ahi.what_helps: Record whether treatment was in use during the study and since then.

visits_household.what_it_is: This combines living arrangements with how often friends or family visit.
visits_household.what_helps: Update both answers when circumstances change.

smokeless.what_it_is: This describes exclusive use of smokeless tobacco over a lifetime.
smokeless.what_helps: Record changes in tobacco use, including past cigarettes.

daily_cigar.what_it_is: This describes daily cigar smoking with no other lifetime tobacco use.
daily_cigar.what_helps: Record the product and frequency separately.

coffee_cups.what_it_is: This describes habitual coffee intake in cups per day.
coffee_cups.what_helps: Use a consistent serving size when recording intake.

tea_cups.what_it_is: This describes habitual tea intake in cups per day.
tea_cups.what_helps: Use a consistent serving size when recording intake.

olive_oil.what_it_is: This describes how much olive oil is usually eaten.
olive_oil.what_helps: Record usual portions across several weeks.

cycle_commute.what_it_is: This describes using a bicycle as the usual way to get to work.
cycle_commute.what_helps: Record the usual journey and update it when the commute changes.

usual_pace.what_it_is: This is how someone rates their usual walking speed.
usual_pace.what_helps: Compare your usual walking pace over time on similar routes.

panel_reference.what_it_is: This survey reference centers the age estimate for people with similar test coverage, age and sex.
panel_reference.what_helps: Compare readings taken with similar sets of measurements.

pushups_max.what_it_is: This counts completed floor push-ups from the toes in one test.
pushups_max.what_helps: Use the same form and stopping rule each time.

racquet_sport.what_it_is: This records recent racquet sports such as tennis, badminton or squash.
racquet_sport.what_helps: Count sessions played in the past four weeks.

swim_participation.what_it_is: This records swimming for exercise in the past four weeks.
swim_participation.what_helps: Record the activity even on days without a watch.

aerobics_participation.what_it_is: This records recent aerobics or keep-fit classes.
aerobics_participation.what_helps: Include classes from the past four weeks.

passive_smoke.what_it_is: This records daily exposure to tobacco smoke at home in someone who has never used tobacco.
passive_smoke.what_helps: Report how often someone smokes inside your home.

fruit_juice.what_it_is: This measures your usual daily amount of pure fruit juice.
fruit_juice.what_helps: Use the glass size and leave out sweetened fruit drinks.

nonrestorative_sleep.what_it_is: This records how often sleep leaves you feeling unrefreshed.
nonrestorative_sleep.what_helps: Report the usual pattern over several weeks.

daytime_sleepiness.what_it_is: This records how often you doze off unintentionally during the day.
daytime_sleepiness.what_helps: Distinguish unplanned dozing from a planned nap.

habitual_nap.what_it_is: This measures the length of a usual daytime nap.
habitual_nap.what_helps: Record typical nap time across several days.

tv_hours.what_it_is: This records time spent watching television on a usual day.
tv_hours.what_helps: Estimate an average across weekdays and weekends.

sleep_initiation.what_it_is: This tracks how often getting to sleep is difficult.
sleep_initiation.what_helps: Think about your usual nights over the past month.

early_waking.what_it_is: This tracks waking too early and having trouble getting back to sleep.
early_waking.what_helps: Think about your usual nights over the past month.

home_stairs.what_it_is: This records how often you climb stairs at home.
home_stairs.what_helps: Count trips up the stairs. About ten steps make one flight.

display_limit.what_it_is: This adjustment keeps extreme combinations within the display range.
display_limit.what_helps: The individual measurements still show which results contributed to the estimate.

yogurt_frequency.what_it_is: This compares your usual yogurt intake with the eating patterns reported in a long-term study.
yogurt_frequency.what_helps: Think about a typical month across the past year when estimating portions.

nut_frequency.what_it_is: This compares your usual nut intake with the eating patterns reported in a long-term study.
nut_frequency.what_helps: Think about a typical month across the past year when estimating portions.

living_alone.what_it_is: This describes whether you share your home with anyone.
living_alone.what_helps: Update your answer if your living arrangements change.

loneliness.what_it_is: This records whether you often feel lonely.
loneliness.what_helps: You can update or skip this answer at any time.

natural_teeth.what_it_is: This compares your tooth count with reports from older adults.
natural_teeth.what_helps: Count a tooth with a crown if it still has its own root.

chewing_change.what_it_is: This records a change in how easily you can chew hard foods.
chewing_change.what_helps: Think about a food you regularly ate six months ago.

widespread_pain.what_it_is: This compares long-lasting pain felt throughout the body with having no long-lasting pain.
widespread_pain.what_helps: Record where you feel pain and when it began. A new answer updates this part of the comparison.

table_salt.what_it_is: This tracks how often you add salt once food is ready to eat.
table_salt.what_helps: Choose the answer that fits your usual meals. Leave out salt used while cooking.

sitting_inactive.what_it_is: This compares sitting time among people who reported no walks for exercise or other moderate or vigorous activity last week.
sitting_inactive.what_helps: Update your usual sitting time and last week’s activity when either changes.

volunteer_hours.what_it_is: This compares volunteer hours spent with organizations over the past year.
volunteer_hours.what_helps: Count unpaid hours with an organization. Leave out informal help you gave on your own.

fried_chicken.what_it_is: This compares how often you ate fried chicken with the eating habits of women after menopause.
fried_chicken.what_helps: Count your usual servings over the past three months.

waist_hip_ratio.what_it_is: This compares your waist and hip measurements with those of people of similar body size.
waist_hip_ratio.what_helps: Keep the tape level and use the same two measuring sites each time.

thigh_cm.what_it_is: This compares your thigh measurement with people of similar body size.
thigh_cm.what_helps: Measure the same right thigh just below the crease each time.

fried_seafood.what_it_is: This compares how often you ate fried fish or shellfish with eating habits after menopause.
fried_seafood.what_helps: Count your usual servings over the past three months.

cycle_participation.what_it_is: This records bicycle rides lasting at least 15 minutes, including trips for transport or fun.
cycle_participation.what_helps: Count rides over the past four weeks, including rides away from work.

weekly_group_activity.what_it_is: This records whether a group activity is part of your usual week.
weekly_group_activity.what_helps: Think about clubs, classes or community gatherings you regularly attend.
